description: Hand a research task to the Exepal Agent: it searches the web, reads public pages (hidden text and prompt injection removed), can run Exepal's checks (launch scan, competitor report, Name Check, SEO data) and returns a sourced answer in Markdown. Read-only; no logins, no lead lists, no personal data. Billed per run from your key's credit: model tokens and tool calls, never more than max_credits (1 credit = $0.01); the unused part of the hold is refunded. Takes 20 seconds to a few minutes.

max_credits.description: Most this run may spend, 5-500 credits (default 30 = $0.30)

model.description: flash (default, cheap) or pro (smarter, about 10x the price)

task.description: The task in plain words, 5 to 4,000 characters, e.g. Compare the paid plans of Plausible and Fathom for 10k pageviews, with links

name: research_agent
title: Exepal Agent (research task)
